title: Utillian 722 Portable Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
Utillian 722 Dry Herb Vaporizer

The Utillian 722 vaporizer refines all the things you loved about the Utillian 721 to create Utillian’s best dry herb vaporizer yet.

The Utillian 722 features convection style heating, single button operation, 4 pre-set temperatures, 30 second heat up, a boost mode for full extraction, a 2300mah battery.

Key Features:
– Convection Heating
– Single Button Operation
– Boost Mode
– Dry Herb and Extract Compatible

BONUS ITEMS: 4 PIECE PREMIUM GRINDER, 2 CLEANING STICKS, 1 BRUSH

Specs:
– Battery 2300mah
– Battery Life 60 Minute
– Heat time 30 Seconds
– Heating Style Convection
– Temperature 180C°, 190C°, 200C°, 210C°, Boost mode = 225C°
– Compatibility Herbs
– Warranty 1 Year

Included in the Box:
– Utillian 722 Vaporizer
– Cleaning Brush
– USB Cable
– Stir Tool
-O-ring and screen set
